pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular dark brown polygons exhibiting deeply serrated, stellate edge gradients. The pixel boundaries show high-frequency projections that interlock with the lighter surrounding space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored negative-space mesh with variable pixel thickness. Junction nodes connect multiple pathways, with significant narrowing occurring where adjacent patch vertices converge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the neck silhouette presents as a dense, low-amplitude fringe with a uniform, high-frequency sawtooth geometric contour.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, dark-colored avian organism (oxpecker) attached to the lower anterior region near the chest/foreleg junction.
